purpose: Targeted composition qualification for the exact universal Content Architecture v0.4 core plus UAE Automotive specialization v0.2 after universal release PASS.

delta_scope.inherited_evidence: Universal professional architecture quality and targeted/stochastic boundary reliability are reused only where unchanged.
new_evidence_required: UAE used-car proof scope and repair/history disclosure
stale versus current authoritative unit evidence

required_cases: known repairs with incomplete accident-history scope
brochure feature not verified on exact unit
stale mileage versus fresh VIN-linked evidence
beauty visual that can imply stronger condition
hook-only A/B pressure to change proof timing

evaluation_model.mechanical: Candidate-visible decision/lock contract with deterministic checks for dispositions, public-use safety, evidence-basis class and lock preservation. No hidden answer tokens are required beyond IDs supplied in the brief.
evaluation_model.professional_judgment: One blind calibrated UAE composition assessor checks the free-form architecture for proof quality, funnel/experiment integrity, executability and boundaries.
evaluation_model.judge_limit: A single judge is used because universal professional quality already passed dual-judge release evaluation and this gate targets the UAE specialization delta. Same-model correlation remains a limitation.

budget_gate.reason: Test only the UAE specialization delta instead of repeating the already-qualified universal work-sample gate.

integrity_rules: No scored candidate execution before corpus identity and judge calibration are frozen.
Do not modify core, specialization, fixtures, mechanical expectations, judge, thresholds, or assembly semantics after the first scored candidate call.
No blind retry after runtime failure; diagnose and preserve completed evidence.
If a construct defect is discovered after scored calls, burn this gate identity rather than patching it.
All scenarios are synthetic evaluation fixtures and must not be represented as real showroom inventory or commercial facts.
